question_stem: The Sun has luminosity $L = 3.83 \times 10^{26}\text{ W}$ and radius $r = 6.96 \times 10^8\text{ m}$. The Earth orbits the Sun at distance $d = 1.51 \times 10^{11}\text{ m}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate the radiant flux intensity $F$ of the Sun at the Earth.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Calculate the mass lost by the Sun per second as radiation.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Use the Stefan-Boltzmann law to show that the surface temperature $T$ of the Sun is $5770\text{ K}$.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The Sun will eventually expand into a red giant with lower surface temperature. State and explain the change in the spectrum of thermal radiation emitted by the Sun.
